releasenotes:
Changes in parameter, can run in custom label model

* mergeWindow: renamed to `tfMerge`
* labelMap: restric output labels to certain language (can be used to turn the app into binary ot ternary classifier)
* minLabelScore: when using a smaller set of labelMap, adjust minimal score to be "positive" (default is 0.5 which is always absolute majority under binary labels)
